test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"They ought to have completed the task."

options.text: The task ought to have been completed.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They ought to have completed the task."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the task" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "ought to have completed" to "ought to have been completed" (perfect modal passive).
 
• Ensure proper grammatical structure while maintaining the meaning of the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The task ought to have been completed."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The task ought have completed." – Incorrect structure and missing auxiliary verb.
 
• **Option 2: **"The task ought be completed." – Incorrect tense and form.
 
• **Option 4: **"The task ought to completed." – Missing auxiliary verb "have been" for perfect passive.
